entities.summary: Yannis Alexis Mardas, also known as Magic Alex, was a Greek self-professed inventor who was closely associated with the Beatles. His nickname was given to him by John Lennon when he was involved with the group between 1965 and 1969, during which time he became head of Apple Electronics. Magic Alex was a architects & engineers from Athens (1942-05-02, Athens–2017-01-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
